description: Airports Council International (ACI World), the trade association of airport operators, collects airport traffic data every year from its airport members and other aviation stakeholders and sells them as datasets, reports and subscriptions. The Annual World Airport Traffic Dataset covers more than 2,600 airports in more than 180 countries and territories, with passengers (international and domestic), air cargo (freight and mail) and aircraft movements (air transport movements and general aviation). Monthly subscriptions cover passengers, cargo and movements for about 1,200 airports, and international traffic for about 900. The Airport Traffic Forecast datasets give forecasts of passengers, cargo tonnes and movements at global, regional and national level for more than 100 countries, and the ACI Intelligence Hub offers dashboards and custom extractions covering up to 95 percent of global commercial air traffic. The coverage is global and national by airport. Access is through paid purchase or subscription, delivered as Excel datasets, reports and online dashboards; ACI members get selected modules free and a free trial is offered. Caveats: figures are reported by participating airports, so coverage varies by month and region, and the data cannot be shared openly. The data support capacity planning, demand calibration for airport and air network models, and hazard exposure studies that weigh airports by traffic. Related records are OurAirports and OpenFlights for airport locations and routes.
